why: Research-compute router (scripts/research/compute_router.py, not imported by the trader): a unit that fetches candles over the network and whose fetch the Kaggle candle dataset does not cover (or that uses the Dukascopy lane) is runner-only without needing a hand-written routing.why_runner.
